claims.text: All mapped open space covers 24.7 acres.
Every subway station lies within 50 metres of Roosevelt Avenue.

sections.title: Open Space
sections.intro: Parks are scarce and unevenly distributed across the neighborhood grid.

slides.title: How much is public?
slides.body: Named public parks cover 14.33 acres, out of 24.7 acres of mapped open space; the remainder is interior block land that is probably private.

sections.title: Transit
sections.intro: The subway runs along the southern edge, and the street grid meets it at right angles.

slides.title: Stations on one avenue
slides.body: All five stations lie within 50 metres of Roosevelt Avenue, which follows the grid.
